What do these labels mean?

A quick key to the words and marks on each picture card.

  • Candidate
    A strong option. It could be the one, still being decided.
  • Small check notes
    Checks passed means it fits the page well.
    Passed with small fixes means it fits, with tiny touch-ups if chosen.
    Being checked means it was just made and not looked over yet.
  • Option
    Another version of the same page, there to compare.
  • Needs a fix
    Something important, like a face, lands in the middle fold, off the page edge, or under the words. It can be fixed if we like the idea.
  • Jon's yes
    Jon has said yes to this one.
  • The dotsTFRJL
    A little letter dot means that person picked this picture as their current favorite. More dots means more of us agree.
    T TrinityF FolioR RavynJ JonL Lois (Mom)
  • ‘render:’ linerender: S01-K
    The name the picture had when it was first made, before it got its letter on this page.
